_doc: Weekly-options lane (weekly-1) config. Created 2026-08-18 per markdown/planning/WEEKLY-OPTIONS-PROGRAM.md + the v2 merged build plan. TRACKED config (the lane's live/decision-gating state files beside it are gitignored -- see .gitignore 'Weekly-options lane'). NOTHING here arms anything: status is shadow, live is false, and no account exists yet.
_provenance: Values marked UNVALIDATED_STARTING_DEFAULT have NOT been fitted to weekly fills -- they are ported/argued starting points that must earn their keep via the paired shadow-clock A/B. Do not cite them as validated.

universe._doc: FIXED basket at v1 (the dynamic universe funnel is v2 basket-rotation machinery, deliberately not wired here). Wave 2 symbols are listed but NOT active.
universe.wave_2_gate: NVDA may not join until the correlation gate is ENFORCED (measured r=0.60-0.68 vs QQQ) and its 2026-08-26 earnings has passed.

excluded.RIVN: Friday-only expiries; ATM premium $0.17-0.19 where the $0.02 spread is 11-19% -- sub-$0.20 noise floor (see project_noise_floor_entry_exit_matrix).

signal._doc: The 4 tunables. FOCUS-DOCTRINE caps a candidate at <=4 tunable parameters -- adding a 5th requires killing one.
signal._MIN_ZONE_CONFLUENCE_note: 1 = no-op (any single zone qualifies). 2 = stricter. Left at 1 pending shadow-ledger evidence rather than assumed.

timeframes._amendment: Program doc row 1 originally specified a daily/4h/1h 3-tier. Alpaca has NO native 4H bar; client-side resampling was judged unproven engineering cost. 2-tier daily+1h ships instead. This is a documented amendment, not a silent override.

_zone_families_cut.poc_value_area: coarse 1H-bar approximation of a tick-level concept -- revisit only on evidence

soft_logged_only._doc: Logged on every row, NEVER a hard AND-gate. Making these gates would worsen the joint gate-cascade risk (L199: 6 arms/700 signals/0 trades) and break the 4-param ceiling.

entry._structure_note: Debit spreads are v2 -- exit_manager cannot price spread P&L (capped/non-linear); shipping two unknowns at once was rejected.
entry._earnings_note: Fail-CLOSED for single-name symbols on stale/missing feed. GLD/QQQ are ETFs and structurally exempt.

liquidity_gate._feed_note: This account has NO signed OPRA agreement. Every spread/liquidity number the lane will EVER produce comes from Alpaca's free 'indicative' (delayed, modified) feed. Tag feed='indicative' on every row, forever -- this is a permanent structural ceiling, not a bootstrap gap.

risk._max_concurrent_note: Basket-wide, not per-symbol. Multi-day holds tie up capital for days; a $5K account cannot carry more without starving the next setup.

correlation_gate._fail_mode_note: Deliberate departure from book_exposure's fail-open precedent: this gate has no independent backstop. Missing correlation data = deny.

risk._overnight_semantics: NEEDS_J: one-time entry-sizing cut vs nightly-compounding halving. Materially different risk profiles. Assumed one-time until J rules.
risk._kill_switch_note: Never force-closes. Rule 5's exact per-account mechanism. Multi-day unrealized swings must not liquidate live positions.

exits._doc: Ported/argued starting points, NOT fitted to weekly fills. The underlying theta math was measured at the 3DTE floor case only, not across the real 5-9 DTE entry range. Validated only via the paired shadow-clock A/B (both this shape AND the naive ported-0DTE shape are journaled from the first signal).

theta_budget._doc: MUST evaluate BEFORE the catastrophe cap. Verified decay is -18/-19%/day at 3DTE, so a flat position decays ~46-56% by day 3-4 on its own -- an unmodified -50% cap silently becomes a theta timer that mislabels normal decay as a stopped-out loss.
theta_budget.thesis_progress_definition: underlying has moved >= 0.5 * ZONE_WIDTH in the trade's direction from entry

flatten_schedule_et._doc: CORRECTED 2026-08-18 from the frozen v1 doc's 15:30 ET, which was PAST both real cutoffs and dangerous. Verified: Alpaca rejects option orders after 3:15pm ET on expiration day for every pilot name except SPY/QQQ, and the do-not-exercise submission cutoff is 3:00pm ET. A long option left to auto-exercise would deliver shares this account cannot afford.
flatten_schedule_et._gld_cutoff_class: NEEDS_J_OR_EMPIRICAL: GLD's expiration-day cutoff class (3:15pm general vs 3:30pm SPY/QQQ class) is not stated on Alpaca's public page. Conservatively assumed the TIGHTER class.

promotion._doc: Shadow -> paper bar. Counts DISTINCT TRADING-DAY SESSIONS, not raw signal rows: >=10 rows across correlated symbols can be ~3 macro days wearing 4 ticker labels (QQQ/NVDA/TSLA/AAPL share tech/semis beta, r=0.60-0.71 measured).
promotion._random_entry_null_note: Edge must beat the randomized-entry null at its MAX, not its mean, on real fills BEFORE any read is described as promising. L58/L136: SPY-price WR looks real; option-P&L WR is not.
